brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested a resident of Masafer Yatta on Wednesday evening, Shehab Wire reported. The detainee was taken from the village, located in the southern West Bank district of Hebron. The circumstances surrounding the arrest and the identity of the detained individual were not disclosed.

Masafer Yatta, situated in Area C of the occupied West Bank, has been a flashpoint for settlement expansion and military operations. The village and surrounding hamlets have faced repeated Israeli raids and arrest campaigns over recent years. Residents of the area have documented numerous incidents of detention and home invasions by Israeli security forces.
